name: National Prayer Breakfast

summary.text: The National Prayer Breakfast began as the Presidential Prayer Breakfast at the Mayflower Hotel in Washington on February 5, 1953, when President Eisenhower attended the dedicatory breakfast of Abraham Vereide's International Christian Leadership at the urging of Senator Frank Carlson and Billy Graham. Hotelier Conrad Hilton is pictured as host of the fourth annual breakfast in 1956.

sources.title: National Prayer Breakfast: What Does Its History Reveal?

facts.claim: The first breakfast was held at the Mayflower Hotel on February 5, 1953 with Eisenhower attending; accounts put attendance at 400–500.
facts.quote: The first Presidential Prayer Breakfast, as it was then called, was held at the Mayflower Hotel

sources.title: National Prayer Breakfast: What Does Its History Reveal?

facts.claim: A 1956 photo caption shows Eisenhower with Conrad Hilton, described as host, as prayer opened the fourth annual breakfast.
facts.quote: Eisenhower standing with Hilton as prayer opened the fourth annual breakfast in 1956

openQuestions: Who paid for the 1953 breakfast is not stated in opened sources.
